patch_description: Add a final monotone exact-score polishing stage after population optimization. The annealed Adam objective is useful for discovering basins, but its final high-beta state can still be slightly misaligned with the nonsmooth objective used by the evaluator. This edit alternates sharp soft contact sets, computes a centered normalized ascent direction, and accepts only backtracking steps that strictly improve the actual squared min/max ratio. It therefore cannot degrade the best recorded configuration and can resolve small residual errors in closest/farthest contact distances.
